_doc: Mira's Black Mirror (research/operators/mira.md §3; Phase 8 M7): her ability, the item in her slot 2 (Z). Placed in `use.placeS` (Fandom: 5 s) on a reinforceable wall, reinforced or not (only from the side its steel went up from), at her head height standing (`mirror.standY` off the floor) or crouched (`mirror.crouchY`), never prone. It burns its window (`sizeM`'s width × height) out of every layer, steel too, and fills it with glass: bulletproof and blast-proof both ways, seen through from her side only (opaque black from the other); a knife hit from either side shatters it (opaque both ways, still bulletproof, Y6S2). Its canister (data/gadgets/mirror_canister.json) sits on her side under the glass: any damage destroys it, and `mirror.ejectS` later the glass is ejected (an open hole in its frame, Fandom). It falls with its wall: when more than `mirror.lossMax` of the band `mirror.frameM` wide round its window is gone through every layer (a soft wall breached round it, a Hard Breach or Exothermic Charge over its frame). It can't be picked up, and its wall can't be reinforced afterwards. 2 a round. Its size (1.0 × 0.35 m by eye), heights, frame and the share of it that holds it are placeholders.
name: Black Mirror
